_producer: src/maintain/fetchers/fetch_arxiv.py (also delegates to src/supabase_source.fetch_papers_by_date_range when Supabase read is enabled)
_producer_notes: Writes a JSON array of paper dicts to archive/${RUN_DATE}/raw/arxiv_papers_${RUN_DATE}.json. Each paper dict is shaped as {id, source, title, abstract, authors, primary_category, categories, published, link}. The schema 'field=papers' check inspects the first element of that array, so required_keys must match the producer's actual keys (paper_id/pdf_url are legacy aliases that do not appear in current output).
